question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (2), **"letters".**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Letters"** is the correct option as it is grammatically correct to use plural form when referring to multiple letters.
 
• The use of singular form "letter" would be incorrect in this context. - Options 3 and 4,** "phrases" and "words", **are not applicable as the question specifically refers to filling in a blank with a certain type of unit. 
 
• The complete phrase will be:*** to write letters __of the English alphabet. ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "letter"**, is incorrect as it does not match the grammatical requirements of the sentence.
 
• Option 3,** "phrases"**, refers to a group of words that express a single idea or concept. 
 
• Option 4,** "words"**, refers to individual units of language that have meaning on their own.
